item.title: Call for Proposals for Special Issues
item.content:encoded:
The journal invites proposals for special issues to be published in 2026. Researchers and scholars are encouraged to submit proposals during the designated submission window.

Appel publié par Journal of Organizational Behavior. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Timeline

  • December 1, 2026: Submission window opens
  • December 31, 2026: Submission window closes
